name: sahyog-care-companion
description: Sahyog Care Companion: agentic patient and doctor workflows

scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: docker compose exec api alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.db:downgrade: docker compose exec api alembic downgrade -1
scripts.lint: docker compose exec api ruff check .
scripts.lint:fix: docker compose exec api ruff check . --fix
scripts.format: docker compose exec api ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: docker compose exec api python -m py_compile sahyog/**/*.py
scripts.deploy:staging: echo 'Configure your staging deployment here' && exit 1
scripts.deploy:prod: echo 'Configure your production deployment here' && exit 1
scripts.clean: docker compose down -v --rmi all && docker system prune -f

author: Sahyog Team
